summaryZh: Benner 实验室开发计算和实验技术，研究调控 DNA、转录、表观遗传及三维基因组之间的关系。它以 csRNA-seq、TSS-MPRA 等方法测量转录起始，分析炎症刺激和非编码变异对转录网络的影响。
researchQuestions: 调控 DNA、转录、表观遗传与三维基因组结构如何相互影响？

evidence.quote: The laboratory develops computational and experimental technologies to study how transcription is regulated, analyzing how regulatory DNA, transcription, epigenetics, and 3D genome structure exert influence on one another.
The laboratory leverages experimental methods to profile transcription initiation in the genome (e.g. csRNA-seq, TSS-MPRA)

model how transcriptional networks respond to inflammatory stimuli or other pathological conditions and monitor the impact that non-coding genetic variation plays in perturbing transcriptional responses.
The Benner Lab is located at the UCSD School of Medicine, in La Jolla, CA.
